An '''office tower''' on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] was owned by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. During the [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|plot to assassinate Senator Amidala]], [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] used this building as her outpost while her [[ASN-121/Legends|ASN-121]] [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] traveled to [[Naboo Queen (restaurant)|the Senator's apartment]]. When the plot was foiled, Wesell shot her droid&mdash;which was carrying [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]&mdash;from the roof.
